cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I open the scholarship letter, please put the tea on saucers. Not beside the envelope; paper and hot drinks need separate areas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've moved the cups. Open it. I want to know if you're leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's still sugar beside it. Clear the sugar away, please. A clean surface means the whole surface.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hold the letter. Are you scared of going, or of staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold it by the edges, please. Not over the cup. If we're doing this in the kitchen, at least let me clear a proper place for you.
